tested_refinement.description: At fixed reduced-mass-ratio-25 GEM geometry, the late-half absolute normalized flux-slope reconnection rate changes monotonically across Ti/Te = 1, 3, 5, 10, 20 with endpoint relative span at least 0.25.
tested_refinement.observation: Both estimators were non-monotone, so the registered monotonicity daughter was falsified. The Ti/Te=1 primary rate was about twice the Ti/Te=20 primary rate in this exploratory seed, motivating but not confirming a held-out endpoint comparison.

prospective_pipeline_audit.assessment: The complete simulator-to-analyzer scientific pipeline was prospectively enumerated and hash sealed. The later analyzer recommission changed only instrument aspect metadata, not source, argv, observable, or scientific decision rule.

operator_audit.qualification: Only one seed was used per Ti/Te point and no resolution or particle-count convergence study separated numerical variability from physical endpoint structure.
report_corrections: The whole sweep was not demonstrated reproducible; only the Ti/Te=5 configuration had one same-input repeat.
Literature searches returned records but did not establish a directly applicable quantitative benchmark for the exact sweep.
The superseded background-density rationale was an unvalidated agent assertion and must not be carried forward as fact.

reuse_policy: This summary and every supplied run-0003 output are discovery context only and are inadmissible as evidence for a new claim.
The exploratory endpoint contrast may motivate a preregistered held-out confirmation using fresh seeds, but it cannot set or satisfy the new evidence outcome.
Seed 20260814 was used in discovery and must not be counted as fresh confirmation evidence.
The next campaign must freeze its full simulator-to-analysis pipeline before generating any claim-bearing confirmation outcome.
If the protocol changes after outcomes are visible, close nondecisively or register a successor and collect fresh observations.
